ToD_A03_M10_VO_S004_001.source_old: I told you this fire was a bad idea!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S004_001.source_new: I told you this fire was a bad idea!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S005_001.source_old: This gold is mine-mine! You no take candle!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S007_001.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r We can feel the place of power where the paladins are strengthening their warriors. |cffffcc00Gall:|r If we defile this place, we can turn its power against them!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S008_001.source_old: We have captured the place of Power!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S008_001.source_new: We have captured the place of Power!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S008_002.source_old: We have lost the place of Power!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S008_002.source_new: We have lost the place of Power!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S009_001.source_old: Stratholme is the heart of Lordaeron, the holiest of cites... your very presence defiles this land, monsters, and you will NOT desecrate it any further!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S009_001.source_new: Stratholme is the heart of Lordaeron, the holiest of cites... your very presence defiles this land, monsters, and you will NOT desecrate it any further!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_001.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Everything has been prepared for your arrival, Warchief.|n|cffffcc00Gall:|r The attack on Stratholme can begin at once, as you demanded!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_001.source_new: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Everything has been prepared for your arrival, Warchief.|n|cffffcc00Gall:|r The attack on Stratholme can begin at once, as you demanded!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_002.source_old: Perfect. My warriors have waited long enough for this battle. Their patience will now be rewarded.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_002.source_new: Perfect. My warriors have waited long enough for this battle. Their patience will now be rewarded.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_003.source_old: Today we strike at the very heart of Lordaeron’s oil production. Without Stratholme, the Alliance’s war effort will grind to a halt, clearing the way to our ultimate goal… Lordaeron’s Capital!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_003.source_new: Today we strike at the very heart of Lordaeron’s oil production. Without Stratholme, the Alliance’s war effort will grind to a halt, clearing the way to our ultimate goal… Lordaeron’s Capital!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_004.source_old: Break through the gates of Stratholme, and unleash the fury of the Horde on its inhabitants!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_004.source_new: Break through the gates of Stratholme, and unleash the fury of the Horde on its inhabitants!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_005.source_old: This city is guarded by some of the most powerful Alliance forces, Warchief. Blindly assaulting the gates will not be enough… the defenders of Stratholme will fight to the death.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_005.source_new: This city is guarded by some of the most powerful Alliance forces, Warchief. Blindly assaulting the gates will not be enough… the defenders of Stratholme will fight to the death.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_006.source_old: Good, then they will die with honor, Warlock. Now step aside, and let the true warriors have their day. wouldn't you say?
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_006.source_new: Good, then they will die with honor, Warlock. Now step aside, and let the true warriors have their day. wouldn't you say?

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_008.source_old: Attack, my warriors! For the Horde!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S010_008.source_new: Attack, my warriors! For the Horde!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S011_001.source_old: Pour the oil down on the gates and set those beasts on fire!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S011_001.source_new: Pour the oil down on the gates and set those beasts on fire!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S012_001.source_old: You! I remember your desecration of Northshire and its noble citizens, Warlock! Your unholy army will fall here.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S012_001.source_new: You! I remember your desecration of Northshire and its noble citizens, Warlock! Your unholy army will fall here.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S012_002.source_old: Ah, an Azerothien remnant.. it’s time that you joined your fallen brethren in death!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S012_002.source_new: Ah, an Azerothien remnant.. it’s time that you joined your fallen brethren in death!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_001.source_old: As you can see Warchief, the defenses of Stratholme are quite formidable. It’s walls cannot be breached through brute strength alone.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_001.source_new: As you can see Warchief, the defenses of Stratholme are quite formidable. It’s walls cannot be breached through brute strength alone.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_002.source_old: Other means must be explored... if we are to taste victory today.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_002.source_new: Other means must be explored... if we are to taste victory today.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_003.source_old: And just what are you suggesting, Gul'Dan?
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_003.source_new: And just what are you suggesting, Gul'Dan?

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_004.source_old: Do you remember the promise I made at the start of your reign?
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_004.source_new: Do you remember the promise I made at the start of your reign?

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_005.source_old: I remember that you were on your knees and begging for your life… speak quickly Gul’dan, for my patience is nearly spent…
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_005.source_new: I remember that you were on your knees and begging for your life… speak quickly Gul’dan, for my patience is nearly spent…

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_006.source_old: I promised you riders of darkness, Warchief, undead wielders of powerful magic to bring ruin to your enemies.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_006.source_new: I promised you riders of darkness, Warchief, undead wielders of powerful magic to bring ruin to your enemies.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_007.source_old: After your warriors killed most of my Shadow Council, I sought ways to create these riders with the aid of my surviving Necrolytes… but they proved incapable of imbuing corpses with true consciousness…
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_007.source_new: After your warriors killed most of my Shadow Council, I sought ways to create these riders with the aid of my surviving Necrolytes… but they proved incapable of imbuing corpses with true consciousness…

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_008.source_old: It was then that I realized… that there is another way…
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_008.source_new: It was then that I realized… that there is another way…

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_009.source_old: But the ritual cannot be done, without sacrifice…
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_009.source_new: But the ritual cannot be done, without sacrifice…

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_010.source_old: Teron’gor, my apprentice, it is time to leave that mortal vessel.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_010.source_new: Teron’gor, my apprentice, it is time to leave that mortal vessel.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_012.source_old: Every dog has its day, Teron, and this is yours… joined by the souls of my failed Necrolytes... now embrace this gift, and seize your destiny, Death Knight!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_012.source_new: Every dog has its day, Teron, and this is yours… joined by the souls of my failed Necrolytes... now embrace this gift, and seize your destiny, Death Knight!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_013.source_old: I… I feel different… I can feel the power inside me! I am now eternal... I am now death incarnate… I am now… Teron Gorefiend!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_013.source_new: I… I feel different… I can feel the power inside me! I am now eternal... I am now death incarnate… I am now… Teron Gorefiend!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_014.source_old: Now, with the souls of the dead, we can turn the fallen knights of our enemies into our servants. The sight of them will tear at the hearts of their human brethren… and fill their souls with terror!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_014.source_new: Now, with the souls of the dead, we can turn the fallen knights of our enemies into our servants. The sight of them will tear at the hearts of their human brethren… and fill their souls with terror!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_015.source_old: You dabble in dangerous magic, Gul’dan… but if these “Death Knights” are as powerful as you say, and loyal to the Horde, you will have proven your usefulness to me. Now... let us put the power of these unliving knights to the test...
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_015.source_new: You dabble in dangerous magic, Gul’dan… but if these “Death Knights” are as powerful as you say, and loyal to the Horde, you will have proven your usefulness to me. Now... let us put the power of these unliving knights to the test...

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_016.source_old: Stratholme is said to be the holiest of cities to the humans. My Death Knights will desecrate it and bring true terror to the hearts of all humans. This entire city… will be purged.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S013_016.source_new: Stratholme is said to be the holiest of cities to the humans. My Death Knights will desecrate it and bring true terror to the hearts of all humans. This entire city… will be purged.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S014_001.source_old: Chieftain! We can’t get through the walls!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S014_001.source_new: Chieftain! We can’t get through the walls!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S014_002.source_old: We need to use our goblin Zeppelins to find vulnerable places where we can breach the walls
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S014_002.source_new: We need to use our goblin Zeppelins to find vulnerable places where we can breach the walls

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_001.source_old: The city is lost… that damnable Warlock has won again. We have but two choices left… stay and fight to the last man, or retreat to the capital.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_001.source_new: The city is lost… that damnable Warlock has won again. We have but two choices left… stay and fight to the last man, or retreat to the capital.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_002.source_old: We’ve run for far too long… and will run no further! But you are the beating heart of the Silver hand… its future depends on your survival.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_002.source_new: We’ve run for far too long… and will run no further! But you are the beating heart of the Silver hand… its future depends on your survival.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_003.source_old: This is Northshire all over again… please, don't make me lose any more of you…
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_003.source_new: This is Northshire all over again… please, don't make me lose any more of you…

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_004.source_old: The light will be with us, Faol, in this life and in the next. Now… go with lord Mograine, I will hold them off.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_004.source_new: The light will be with us, Faol, in this life and in the next. Now… go with lord Mograine, I will hold them off.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_005.source_old: May the light protect you, child.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_005.source_new: May the light protect you, child.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_006.source_old: Your name will be itched in the memories of all Knights of the Silver Hand, brave Mara… farewell…
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S015_006.source_new: Your name will be itched in the memories of all Knights of the Silver Hand, brave Mara… farewell…

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S016_001.source_old: Come then… you savages! Taste the wrath of the light!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S016_001.source_new: Come then… you savages! Taste the wrath of the light!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S016_002.source_old: Bolvar, in the light we are one...
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S016_002.source_new: Bolvar, in the light we are one...

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S017_001.source_old: With the fall of Stratholme, victory in this war is finally within our grasp. Once we destroy the Capital of Lordaeron, and Zul’jin burns Quel’thalas to the ground, none will remain with the power to oppose us!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S017_001.source_new: With the fall of Stratholme, victory in this war is finally within our grasp. Once we destroy the Capital of Lordaeron, and Zul’jin burns Quel’thalas to the ground, none will remain with the power to oppose us!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S017_002.source_old: Then, at long last, we can ensure a proud and glorious future for the orcs on this world, and everyone brave enough to stand with us!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S017_002.source_new: Then, at long last, we can ensure a proud and glorious future for the orcs on this world, and everyone brave enough to stand with us!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S017_003.source_old: Glory to the Horde! Victory or Death!
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S017_003.source_new: Glory to the Horde! Victory or Death!

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S018_001.source_old: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Master, what will we do now?|n|cffffcc00Gall:|r Doomhammer and his forces will be moving west very soon.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S018_001.source_new: |cffffcc00Cho:|r Master, what will we do now?|n|cffffcc00Gall:|r Doomhammer and his forces will be moving west very soon.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S018_002.source_old: We will be moving north, my apprentices, as there is something in Quel’thalas that I need for the next step of my plan.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S018_002.source_new: We will be moving north, my apprentices, as there is something in Quel’thalas that I need for the next step of my plan.

ToD_A03_M10_VO_S018_003.source_old: Gather the warriors… it is time to “reinforce” Zul’jin.
ToD_A03_M10_VO_S018_003.source_new: Gather the warriors… it is time to “reinforce” Zul’jin.
